title: Sources: Solidigm, SK Hynix's US unit, seeks US government approval to export US chipmaking equipment to Dalian, China, as a condition for building a US factory (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: Solidigm, SK Hynix's US unit, seeks US government approval to export US chipmaking equipment to Dalian, China, as a condition for building a US factory — South Korea's SK Hynix is seeking approval from Washington to export US chipmaking equipment to China to increase production …
